title: Rust rf_health: NaN/inf poisoning in RF metric setters — is_nan should be !is_finite (residue from b7z9.24.2 review)
description: Residue from the multi-root root-selection review (worker1 b7z9.24.2 round). rust/lichen-core/src/rf_health.rs with_rf_metrics/with_rssi_ema/with_snr_ema use is_nan() to sanitize but should use !is_finite() — +INFINITY/-INFINITY passes is_nan and poisons the density estimate (a beacon with rssi=inf would make estimate_density unusable). Three one-line changes plus a test pinning that inf is treated as worst-case.
close_reason: Not applicable: the current rust/lichen-core/src/rf_health.rs does not have with_rf_metrics/with_rssi_ema/with_snr_ema float setters — those were part of an earlier API shape that was refactored to integer-typed setters (record_rx takes i8, record_density takes u8, record_load_factor takes u32), all of which are inherently finite. The inf-poisoning vector no longer exists in the current code. Closing as moot.
